preconditions.expression: t == int(stdin.split()[0]) and t >= 1 and t <= 100
preconditions.description: The first line of input is an integer t (1 ≤ t ≤ 100) representing the number of test cases.

preconditions.expression: all(len(lines) == 2 * t for lines in [stdin.splitlines()[i:i+2*t] for i in range(0, len(stdin.splitlines()), 2*t)])
preconditions.description: Input consists of exactly 2t lines after the first line: t pairs of lines per test case, where each pair is (n, s).

preconditions.expression: all(n == int(lines[2*i]) and n >= 1 and n <= 10**5 for i in range(t))
preconditions.description: For each test case, the first line of the pair is an integer n (1 ≤ n ≤ 10^5) representing the length of the string s.

preconditions.expression: all(len(lines[2*i+1]) == n for i in range(t))
preconditions.description: For each test case, the second line of the pair is a string s of length n consisting of lowercase English letters.

preconditions.expression: all(all(c in 'abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz' for c in lines[2*i+1]) for i in range(t))
preconditions.description: Each character in s is a lowercase English letter.

postconditions.description: The output contains exactly t space-separated integers, one per test case.

postconditions.expression: all(output == '-1' or (output >= 0 and output <= n) for output, n in zip(stdout.split(), [int(stdin.splitlines()[2*i]) for i in range(t)]))
postconditions.description: For each test case, the output is either -1 (impossible) or a non-negative integer ≤ n (minimum deletions required).

postconditions.expression: all((output == '-1' and not any(is_palindrome(s, c) for c in set(s))) or (output >= 0 and any(is_palindrome(s, c) and count_deletions(s, c) == output for c in set(s))) for output, s in zip(stdout.split(), [stdin.splitlines()[2*i+1] for i in range(t)]))
postconditions.description: For each test case, if output is -1, no single letter deletion can make s a palindrome. Otherwise, output is the minimum deletions required across all possible letters c ∈ s, where is_palindrome(s, c) checks if s becomes a palindrome after deleting some occurrences of c, and count_deletions(s, c) returns the minimum deletions needed for that c.

postconditions.expression: all((output == '-1' or (output == 0 and is_palindrome(s, c) for some c in set(s))) for output, s in zip(stdout.split(), [stdin.splitlines()[2*i+1] for i in range(t)]))
postconditions.description: If the string is already a palindrome (output = 0), it must be possible to choose some letter c ∈ s and delete zero occurrences of c to leave the string unchanged as a palindrome.
